description: This PHP source file defines the class 'ProjectListViewSmarty', which extends 'ListViewSmarty' to customize list view behavior for the 'Project' module in SuiteCRM. It includes methods for constructing export links tailored to different SugarCRM versions.

classes.name: ProjectListViewSmarty
classes.description: A subclass of ListViewSmarty that adds functionality for building customized export and map links in the context of the 'Project' module.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ProjectListViewSmarty instance and assigns a new ProjectListViewData to the 'lvd' property.

methods.name: buildExportLink
methods.description: Generates HTML links for exporting data and displaying maps, with variations depending on the version of SugarCRM detected.
